name: Nerin
desc:
Nerin is an Etrean NPC. He accepts a bribe for [Etrea](faction:etrea).

The Pathfinder can pay him up to 1,200 to restore their reputation back to neutral.
additional_info: -   The dialogue when you attempt to bribe with not enough money "Hah! Not a penny on you, poor sap. Come back when you're a little, hmm, richer?" is a quote reference to Morshu from _Link: The Faces of Evil_.
